title: Green Ocean Campaign - Da Nang
location: My Khe Beach & Son Tra Peninsula
description: Collecting ocean plastic waste, protecting the coral reef ecosystem, and raising awareness among fishermen and coastal tourists about reducing single-use plastics.
meetingPoint: Bien Dong Park, Vo Nguyen Giap Street, Son Tra

schedule.activity: Gather at the meeting point: Bien Dong Park, check-in and gear distribution
Warm-up, safety briefing, and team assignment by cleanup zone
Beach cleanup, sorting recyclable, organic, and hazardous waste
Load collected waste onto trucks, weigh the total, take group photos and wrap up
